checks.text: The page displays the heading "Chore Chart" and, in the "Members" tab, the text "No members yet".
In the "Members" tab, typing "Alice" in the field labelled "Name" and clicking the button "Add member" adds a list item containing "Alice" and the text "0 chores".
In the "Members" tab, typing "Bob" in the field labelled "Name" and clicking the button "Add member" adds a list item containing "Bob" and the text "0 chores".

Clicking the button "Assign chore" on the list item for "Alice" opens a form. Typing "Dishes" in the field labelled "Chore name" and clicking "Save" adds a row to the "Chores" tab table with "Alice" in the "Member" column and "Dishes" in the "Chore" column. The "Members" tab list item for "Alice" now shows "1 chores".
In the "Chores" tab, clicking the checkbox in the row for "Dishes" changes the "Status" column for that row to "Done" and displays a progress indicator "1/1" for Alice in the "Members" tab.
In the "Chores" tab, clicking the button "Export CSV" displays a toast with the text "CSV copied to clipboard" and copies the text "Member,Chore,Status\nAlice,Dishes,Done\n" to the clipboard.
In the "Members" tab, clicking the button "Remove Alice" removes the list item for "Alice" and all associated chores from the "Chores" tab table.
Typing "Charlie" in the "Name" field and clicking "Add member", then assigning a chore "Laundry" to Charlie, results in the "Chores" tab table showing a row with "Charlie" and "Laundry".
Reload keeps the member "Alice" with the chore "Dishes" marked as "Done" in the "Chores" tab table.
